# PeerJS 1.5.5

Pinned browser distribution for Formula Club. No runtime package installation is required.

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/peerjs/v/1.5.5
- Source: https://github.com/peers/peerjs/tree/v1.5.5
- Download: https://unpkg.com/peerjs@1.5.5/dist/peerjs.min.js
- License: [MIT](peerjs.LICENSE)
- SHA-256 of `peerjs.min.js`: `7604d8c31bec4f134b0d15c2d80b1d095ea18af005354f439f14291fcd7b4168`

The default configuration uses PeerJS Cloud signaling and STUN/TURN connectivity services. Preserve those defaults when upgrading unless replacement services are configured. Multiplayer needs network access to those services; solo games do not.
